d: Company Description White Roastery is a Kuwait-based specialty coffee company focused on delivering exceptional coffee experiences through premium roasting, fresh bakery products, and café operations. The company serves cafés, restaurants, offices, and businesses with tailored coffee solutions, equipment, training, and ongoing support. With a strong commitment to quality and craftsmanship, White Roastery carefully sources and roasts specialty coffee beans to elevate coffee culture. Its services include specialty coffee roasting, wholesale coffee supply (B2B), bakery and café operations, coffee equipment and accessories, barista training and consultation, and corporate coffee solutions.

Role Description The Account Manager F&B is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City, responsible for managing and growing relationships with key food and beverage clients. This role oversees account portfolios, identifies business opportunities, and ensures that clients receive tailored coffee, bakery, and equipment solutions aligned with their operational needs. Day-to-day tasks include conducting client meetings, preparing proposals and quotations, coordinating product deliveries, and monitoring service quality and customer satisfaction. The Account Manager F&B collaborates closely with roasting, operations, and training teams to support client onboarding, product launches, menu development, and promotional activities. The role also involves tracking account performance, resolving issues, maintaining accurate records in CRM or sales systems, and providing regular reports and forecasts to management.
To handle B2B existing accounts and generate new leads.
q: Strong account management and client relationship skills, preferably within F&B, hospitality, or retail environments.
Sales, negotiation, and business development abilities with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
Operational understanding of café, restaurant, or bakery workflows and familiarity with coffee products, equipment, and service standards.
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across internal teams and engage diverse stakeholders.
Solid organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, including proficiency with CRM tools and basic MS Office or Google Workspace.
Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills and prior experience in the Gulf region are considered an advantage.
Ability to work on-site in Kuwait City, visit client locations regularly, and adapt to a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
